title: Drugs Dataset
description: Offgrid drugs feed with street stock formulas and procedural generation options.
author: Hendo

street_stock.Description: Street stock combat and utility compounds.

synthcoke.name: SynthCoke
synthcoke.description: The second generation synthetic replacement for cocaine. Side effects are nasty: paranoia and psychological addiction.

stim.name: Stim
stim.description: Stim increases endurance, allowing the user to stay alert for longer periods. Side effects include mental delusions.

syncomp_15.name: Syncomp 15
syncomp_15.description: Syncomp is a broad-spectrum poison antidote used to treat nerve and biotoxins. REF is reduced at the rate of 1 point per dose.

speedheal.name: Speedheal
speedheal.description: Speedheal is designed to enhance natural healing processes. Side effect: REF reduced by 1D6/3 for one week after use.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Boost raises INT by +1 for a 2-7 hour period. Frequent users build tolerance and may crash into screaming fits and hallucinations without repeated doses.

blue_glass.name: Blue Glass
blue_glass.description: Originally developed as a biological weapon. Under stress there is a 3 in 10 chance of flashing out; reduce INT by 1 per dose.

smash.name: Smash
smash.description: Smash is 2020's answer to alcohol. It makes you loose, happy and ready to party, but crash withdrawal can trigger suicidal episodes and catatonia.

dorph.name: 'Dorph
dorph.effects: Reduces pain, stun and shock impact
dorph.description: Combat painkiller based on endorphins. Each use adds one extra 1D10 roll; on a 1, user permanently loses 1 point of REF.

black_lace.name: Black Lace
black_lace.effects: Euphoria, adrenal rush and pain invulnerability
black_lace.description: High-powered version of 'Dorph. Raises CL by 2 and grants resistance to stun/shock, but addiction and EMP loss can trigger cyberpsychosis.

riskOptions.label: Psychological Addiction
riskOptions.rule: Character must roll under CL each hour after dose ends; failed roll leads to panic, depression and compulsive drug-seeking.

riskOptions.label: Physiological Addiction
riskOptions.rule: Character must roll under BT each hour after dose ends; failed roll causes pain and damage until next dose.

riskOptions.label: Death
riskOptions.rule: Each use requires a Death Save with negative modifier equal to drug Strength minus one.

riskOptions.label: Reduced REF
riskOptions.rule: Reduces REF by 1 point per dose for duration; cumulative if redosed before expiration.

riskOptions.label: Reduced INT
riskOptions.rule: Reduces INT by 1 point per dose for duration; cumulative if redosed before expiration.

riskOptions.label: Tremors
riskOptions.rule: Causes painful hand and face tremors.

riskOptions.label: Hallucinations
riskOptions.rule: Causes visual/audio hallucinations; may persist as recurring bad trip at referee discretion.

riskOptions.label: Paranoia
riskOptions.rule: Character becomes hyper-suspicious and defensive against perceived threats.

riskOptions.label: Delusions
riskOptions.rule: Character believes false realities and acts to preserve them.

riskOptions.label: Sterility
riskOptions.rule: Causes permanent sterility on a 3 in 10 chance.

riskOptions.label: Carcinogenic
riskOptions.rule: 1 in 10 chance to develop cancer; causes permanent damage unless treated by very difficult medical check.

riskOptions.label: Psychotic Rage
riskOptions.rule: Character may fly into psychotic rage and attack anyone nearby.

riskOptions.label: Aggressive Behavior
riskOptions.rule: Character becomes irritable and aggressive; on 5 in 10 chance starts a fight with nearest person.

riskOptions.label: Irrational Fear
riskOptions.rule: Character becomes irrationally fearful and may freeze or fall into catatonia until drug wears off.

riskOptions.label: Nerve Degeneration
riskOptions.rule: Causes severe nerve damage; user loses 2 REF permanently.

formula.notes: Side effects use negative points and reduce build difficulty; duration applies as multiplier.

warnings: Drugs are dangerous and can permanently damage stats.
You can buy down cost by adding side effects.
Final dose cost uses 25 eb per point of final creation difficulty.
